SESSION 2026-08-06/07 — orphan triage, bridge-redesign planning, and a large parallel remediation round.

STARTED AS: list open epics with child counts, plus open bugs/tasks/stories with no parent. Grew into a full remediation session.

HEADLINE NUMBERS
* Orphan tickets (open, parentless bug/task/story): 75 -> 44.
* ~48 commits landed on origin/main.
* Tickets closed this session: 192e, 3787, c08d, ab79, two jira probes, 2a76, 8de5, ed5e, 3bdf, 5dd2, e5ec, 39c5, 83f2, 3b92, 46a2, e6a0, 0ba2, 354d, 78f4, 0ee6, c494, d166, 7c58, e548, a5f5, d5ae, dbb2, a371, 4c2b, 4bf4, 2be7, 851e, 65d7, ccf6, 13b4, 599e, 63e8, e7a9, 6067, 24f7.

EPIC 2f79 (bridge redesign) — PLANNED AND SPLIT
* Was 9 children with ZERO dependency edges and ZERO declared file impact. Now: file impact on all children, 15+ dependency edges, acyclic, two roots.
* 4752 would not converge under plan review (findings went 2 -> 7 -> 4 -> 7) because it bundled three verb retirements, a flag removal, three renames, a new verb and a production workflow rewiring. SPLIT into: 4752 (verb group, rescoped), c61a (retire dead verbs), 4a44 (retire reconcile + --mode), e27c (rename survivors).
* 1c1b CERTIFIED (plan-review PASS) after six rounds; findings fell 3->3->2->1->2->0.
* Review found real defects, not presentation: push.py would have pushed NOTHING after the YAML deletion (no staging/commit); a SECOND undiscovered CAS loop in the canary workflow; 1c1b depending on the BRIDGE_ALERT emitter that 030f deletes; reconcile/--mode living on THREE surfaces while the plan enumerated one.

OPERATOR DECISIONS RECORDED
* e7a9: REFUSE secret-bearing writes, with an allowed force override. Redaction rejected. IMPLEMENTED AND MERGED (33d6d4ef7c).
* 2876: direct-Anthropic arm IS approved as a fallback.
* 24f7: clean break, no alias. MERGED.
* 5e53: module-size remediation DEFERRED.
* 858c: an unmeetable AC is a defect in the AC, remediate before close — BUT genuinely N/A for a won't-fix/obsolete disposition. Reopened and rescoped to a disposition-keyed mechanism keyed off --class.
* 63e8: advisories block the SCHEDULED main run and RELEASES; Gerrit verify blocks only when the change touches the dependency map ('if you touch it, you own it'). Severity bar CRITICAL/HIGH fail, MEDIUM warn, LOW track; UNRATED treated as HIGH. override-dependencies approved as a documented escape hatch. MERGED (0767c38ebb).
* 9fb3: DROP inspect-ai (option A) — it is never imported yet is the sole cause of both [tool.uv] conflicts entries AND the click override behind PYSEC-2026-2132. IN FLIGHT.
* 556a: option E — do NOT move inbound_fields.py; rewrite the exemption to state it is the deliberate price of the J7 adapter seal.
* 81d5: option B — anti-drift guard, not the glob. AC3 needs rewording.
* 8fbd-e9d5: fallback chain stays OFF and the fix is COMMITTED TO (not deferred) — capability intersection silently downgrades every standard-class call project-wide.
* 7084: R5 (name the lock holder, using EXISTING stamp machinery) + R1 (batch the introducing-commit resolution) + R3 (lock-polite compact-on-close; load is intermittent so no skip-floor needed) APPROVED. R2/R4/R6 declined. Per-ticket locking recorded as a FUTURE consideration if round 1 underdelivers.
